blind.description: A modular straight wall section representing a mine or dungeon wall. It consists of a carved rock/stone face flanked and topped by dark timber beams. A thick horizontal wooden beam caps the top, secured with metal brackets, while a vertical timber post with diagonal corner braces runs down the center of each face, reinforced by metal plates/straps. The lower section of the stone features painted green moss. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and stylized hand-painted low-poly geometry with no floating or broken parts.
blind.from_above: A simple narrow wooden rectangle representing the top surface of the wooden capping beam, with slight bracket protrusions along the long sides, casting a long diagonal shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.3 to 1.4 times as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 7.5 to 8 ft tall), and about 3.5 to 4 ft wide.
